sentences.text: Annex two describes extra signals for fishing vessels fishing in close proximity.
These lights are placed lower than the Rule twenty-six lights and are visible at least one mile.
A trawler may show two white lights in a vertical line when shooting her nets, white over red when hauling her nets, and two red lights in a vertical line when her net is fast on an obstruction.
Vessels pair trawling may direct a searchlight forward and toward the other vessel of the pair.
A purse seiner hampered by her gear may show two yellow lights in a vertical line, flashing alternately.
The exam usually asks you to match each signal to its meaning.
